label: Own app pages: create, get, update (replace/append), clio and Go baselines both ways, sync, conflict
why: The app (and its package) is created through clio on both sides until this server has create-app; both pages live in that package. get-page / update-page steps alternate between the servers on the same .clio-pages baseline.
